content.title: Retinal screening result
content.body: The eye scan model scored 0.78 out of 1 and found 6 tiny bulges in the small vessels at the back of your eye. This is a screening test and not a diagnosis. Please book an eye doctor visit within 14 days so a specialist can look at your eye and confirm what the scan found.
recommendations: Book an eye doctor visit within 14 days.
